leadText:
Harmony (Japanese: ホノカ Honoka) is a character of the day who appeared in Out of Their Elements!. Harmony is a circus performer specializing in types.

Harmony was first seen practicing a performance alongside her nicknamed Bernice, which she planned to evolve into a during the next performance. While talking to , Goh, and Chloe, a Thunder Stone was accidentally dropped on her Eevee, causing her to evolve into . 's Eevee accidentally became a Flareon, so Harmony took him instead but he refused to listen to her commands. While practicing with her other Pokémon, Bernice showed off her and Harmony was able to come up with a plan which involved Billy and Chloe's Eevee to do a performance.

After their performance, Harmony provided Chloe with a Fire Stone so that Chloe could evolve her Eevee into a Flareon one day.

She reappeared in a flashback in Infinite Possibilities!.

In Heroes Unite!, Harmony reappeared in a fantasy, alongside other Trainers Chloe and her Eevee met.
